source.quote: You have 12 of 12 Focus. Echo has 0 of 8 Focus. Echo is your summoned familiar and is absent. Echo's Focus costs are paid one for one from your Focus. Recall costs 2 Focus and summons Echo for 1 subsequent action of yours. Dismiss dismisses Echo. Echo's Beacon costs 3 Focus and grants Echo a Beacon condition until dismissed. Echo has an injured wing.
